div.span:
• Visual Prior: Pretrained on ImageNet-1k (1.28M natural images), providing low-level edge filters and mid-level geometric primitives.
• Differential Learning Rates: Backbone fine-tuned at to preserve generic visual features; convex linear head trained at ( ratio) for task specialization.
• Optimization: AdamW optimizer with weight decay , Cosine Annealing learning rate schedule, and label smoothing .
• Convergence: Best validation performance reached at Epoch 10.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 744px; height: 1px; padding-top: 473px; margin-left: 779px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.span:
• Test Generalization: 91.86% Top-1 Accuracy and 91.10% Macro-F1 across 7,200 unseen test samples (Signers P9 & P10).
• Perfect Recognition: 24 of 36 distinct fingerspelling classes achieve 100.0% precision, recall, and F1 score.
• Homograph Concentration: 91.5% of total errors (536 / 586 misclassifications) occur across 5 static visual pairs: (311), (108), (100), (98), and (65).
• Static Limit: Signs requiring dynamic gesture trajectories ( and ) exhibit intrinsic single-frame projection ambiguity.

display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-style: italic; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Figure 3. Architectural blueprint of Model 3 (Transfer Learning ResNet-18). The network couples an ImageNet-1k pretrained ResNet-18 vision backbone (11,176,512 parameters) with a regularized linear projection head (18,468 parameters, 11,194,980 total). Differential optimization enables transferring foundational visual representations while adapting to fingerspelling classification.
